newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: SAA starts direct flights to Japan in Apri.
newsitem.headline: SAA starts direct flights to Japan in Apri.

text.p: South African Airways (SAA) said on Thursday it would start operating a twice weekly flight to Japan from April 3 and had strengthened its relationship with Thai Airways International PCL.

"A memorandum of understanding with Japan Airlines (and SAA) committing the two airlines to a closer co-operation in the future has been signed and the present agreement with Thai Airways International has also been further expanded," SAA said in a statement.

SAA said the flights would depart from Johannesburg on Thursdays and Sundays and leave Osaka on Fridays and Sundays. Japan Airlines Co Ltd would provide further connecting flights from Osaka to Tokyo and other major cities in Japan.
It said it had also introduced a codeshare agreement on the Johannesburg/Bangkok route.
SAA said it was confident that the new direct service to Japan would lead to an increase in tourism and business travel from Japan.
